from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "ELISA Transfer Protocol", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Define liquids: standards 1-8
    for i in range(1, 9):
        protocol.define_liquid(f"standard {i}", description=f"Standard {i}", display_color="#FF0000")
    # Define liquids: serum 1-40
    for i in range(1, 41):
        protocol.define_liquid(f"serum {i}", description=f"Serum {i}", display_color="#00FF00")
    
    # Load labware
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 1)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_12_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    elisa_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 3, label="Coated ELISA Plate")
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 4)
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Generate list of well names for the first 40 wells in row-major order
    well_names = []
    for row in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]:
        for col in range(1, 13):
            well_names.append(row + str(col))
    serum_well_names = well_names[:40]
    
    # Load serum liquids into source plate wells
    for i in range(40):
        well_name = serum_well_names[i]
        source_plate[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=f"serum {i+1}", volume=100)
    
    # Define mapping of standard index to tuberack well name
    standard_source_well_names = ["A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5", "A6", "B1", "B2"]
    # Load standard liquids into tuberack wells
    for i in range(8):
        well_name = standard_source_well_names[i]
        tuberack[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=f"standard {i+1}", volume=100)
    
    # Perform transfers using a single tip
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    # Transfer serum samples (40 transfers)
    for i in range(40):
        src_well = source_plate[serum_well_names[i]]
        dest_well = elisa_plate[serum_well_names[i]]  # same well name
        p300.aspirate(100, src_well)
        p300.dispense(100, dest_well)
    # Transfer standards (8 transfers)
    for i in range(8):
        src_well = tuberack[standard_source_well_names[i]]
        # Compute destination well name in column 12
        row_letter = chr(ord('A') + i)
        dest_well_name = row_letter + "12"
        dest_well = elisa_plate[dest_well_name]
        p300.aspirate(100, src_well)
        p300.dispense(100, dest_well)
    # Drop tip
    p300.drop_tip()
```

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "ELISA Transfer Protocol", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Define liquids: standards 1-8
    standard_liquids = {}
    for i in range(1, 9):
        standard_liquids[f"standard {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"standard {i}",
            description=f"Standard {i}",
            display_color="#FF0000"
        )
    # Define liquids: serum 1-40
    serum_liquids = {}
    for i in range(1, 41):
        serum_liquids[f"serum {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"serum {i}",
            description=f"Serum {i}",
            display_color="#00FF00"
        )
    
    # Load labware
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 1)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    elisa_plate = protocol.load_labware("corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat", 3, label="Coated ELISA Plate")
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 4)
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Generate list of well names for the first 40 wells in row-major order
    well_names = []
    for row in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]:
        for col in range(1, 13):
            well_names.append(row + str(col))
    serum_well_names = well_names[:40]
    
    # Load serum liquids into source plate wells
    for i in range(40):
        well_name = serum_well_names[i]
        source_plate[well_name].load_liquid(
            liquid=serum_liquids[f"serum {i+1}"],
            volume=100
        )
    
    # Define mapping of standard index to tuberack well name
    standard_source_well_names = ["A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5", "A6", "B1", "B2"]
    # Load standard liquids into tuberack wells
    for i in range(8):
        well_name = standard_source_well_names[i]
        tuberack[well_name].load_liquid(
            liquid=standard_liquids[f"standard {i+1}"],
            volume=100
        )
    
    # Perform transfers using a fresh tip for each transfer to avoid cross-contamination
    # Transfer serum samples (40 transfers)
    for i in range(40):
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        src_well = source_plate[serum_well_names[i]]
        dest_well = elisa_plate[serum_well_names[i]]  # same well name
        p300.aspirate(100, src_well)
        p300.dispense(100, dest_well)
        p300.drop_tip()
    # Transfer standards (8 transfers)
    for i in range(8):
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        src_well = tuberack[standard_source_well_names[i]]
        # Compute destination well name in column 12
        row_letter = chr(ord('A') + i)
        dest_well_name = row_letter + "12"
        dest_well = elisa_plate[dest_well_name]
        p300.aspirate(100, src_well)
        p300.dispense(100, dest_well)
        p300.drop_tip()"}

tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "ELISA Transfer Protocol", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Define liquids: standards 1-8
    standard_liquids = {}
    for i in range(1, 9):
        standard_liquids[f"standard {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"standard {i}",
            description=f"Standard {i}",
            display_color="#FF0000"
        )
    # Define liquids: serum 1-40
    serum_liquids = {}
    for i in range(1, 41):
        serum_liquids[f"serum {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"serum {i}",
            description=f"Serum {i}",
            display_color="#00FF00"
        )
    
    # Load labware
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 1)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    elisa_plate = protocol.load_labware("corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat", 3, label="Coated ELISA Plate")
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 4)
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Generate list of well names for the first 40 wells in row-major order
    well_names = []
    for row in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]:
        for col in range(1, 13):
            well_names.append(row + str(col))
    serum_well_names = well_names[:40]
    
    # Load serum liquids into source plate wells
    for i in range(40):
        well_name = serum_well_names[i]
        source_plate[well_name].load_liquid(
            liquid=serum_liquids[f"serum {i+1}"],
            volume=100
        )
    
    # Define mapping of standard index to tuberack well name
    standard_source_well_names = ["A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5", "A6", "B1", "B2"]
    # Load standard liquids into tuberack wells
    for i in range(8):
        well_name = standard_source_well_names[i]
        tuberack[well_name].load_liquid(
            liquid=standard_liquids[f"standard {i+1}"],
            volume=100
        )
    
    # Perform transfers using a fresh tip for each transfer to avoid cross-contamination
    # Transfer serum samples (40 transfers)
    for i in range(40):
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        src_well = source_plate[serum_well_names[i]]
        dest_well = elisa_plate[serum_well_names[i]]  # same well name
        p300.aspirate(100, src_well)
        p300.dispense(100, dest_well)
        p300.drop_tip()
    # Transfer standards (8 transfers)
    for i in range(8):
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        src_well = tuberack[standard_source_well_names[i]]
        # Compute destination well name in column 12
        row_letter = chr(ord('A') + i)
        dest_well_name = row_letter + "12"
        dest_well = elisa_plate[dest_well_name]
        p300.aspirate(100, src_well)
        p300.dispense(100, dest_well)
        p300.drop_tip()"}

That means that each serum sample should be transferred to the destination well with the same name as the source well. That is what we did.

For the "standards" group, it says "where": "any of A12..H12 (8 wells)", "order": ".

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "ELISA Transfer Protocol", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Define liquids: standards 1-8
    standard_liquids = {}
    for i in range(1, 9):
        standard_liquids[f"standard {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"standard {i}",
            description=f"Standard {i}",
            display_color="#FF0000"
        )
    # Define liquids: serum 1-40
    serum_liquids = {}
    for i in range(1, 41):
        serum_liquids[f"serum {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"serum {i}",
            description=f"Serum {i}",
            display_color="#00FF00"
        )
    
    # Load labware
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 1)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    elisa_plate = protocol.load_labware("corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat", 3, label="Coated ELISA Plate")
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 4)
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Generate list of well names for the first 40 wells in row-major order
    well_names = []
    for row in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]:
        for col in range(1, 13):
            well_names.append(row + str(col))
    serum_well_names = well_names[:40]
    
    # Load serum liquids into source plate wells
    for i in range(40):
        well_name = serum_well_names[i]
        source_plate[well_name].load_liquid(
            liquid=serum_liquids[f"serum {i+1}"],
            volume=100
        )
    
    # Define mapping of standard index to tuberack well name
    standard_source_well_names = ["A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5", "A6", "B1", "B2"]
    # Load standard liquids into tuberack wells
    for i in range(8):
        well_name = standard_source_well_names[i]
        tuberack[well_name].load_liquid(
            liquid=standard_liquids[f"standard {i+1}"],
            volume=100
        )
    
    # Perform transfers using a fresh tip for each transfer to avoid cross-contamination
    # Transfer serum samples (40 transfers)
    for i in range(40):
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        src_well = source_plate[serum_well_names[i]]
        dest_well = elisa_plate[serum_well_names[i]]  # same well name
        p300.aspirate(100, src_well)
        p300.dispense(100, dest_well)
        p300.drop_tip()
    # Transfer standards (8 transfers)
    for i in range(8):
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        src_well = tuberack[standard_source_well_names[i]]
        # Compute destination well name in column 12
        row_letter = chr(ord('A') + i)
        dest_well_name = row_letter + "12"
        dest_well = elisa_plate[dest_well_name]
        p300.aspirate(100, src_well)
        p300.dispense(100, dest_well)
        p300.drop_tip()"}
